Loss report: gitea -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (Tekton schedules pods, not runner labels)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.tags (a glob has no exact CEL regex, so the filter is false and the trigger never fires; the globs stay in the marker)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.tag: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
